marta-eng: Hi team — urgent: my elderly parent needs emergency care Dec 25 and I need to travel last-minute. There's a PTO blackout Dec 22-28 because of the company shutdown. Can I get an exception for compassionate leave without using my PTO bucket?

olivia-peopleops: Sorry to hear that, Marta. We do offer compassionate leave exceptions during blackout windows on a case-by-case basis. For emergency family care we can grant up to 3 paid compassionate days (separate from PTO) pending manager approval and HR confirmation. Please don't book until we confirm payroll cutoffs.

marta-eng: Thanks. What's the exact process? I need to book tonight.

olivia-peopleops: Steps: 1) Submit People Portal -> Leave Exceptions -> select "Compassionate/Emergency". 2) Attach supporting note (doctor/hospital or brief note). 3) Manager (vince-mgr) approves in portal. 4) People Ops escalates to payroll if payout needed before cutoff. If payroll cutoff for Dec payroll has passed, we'll grant paid compassionate days as "shutdown credit" that appear as separate paid entries in Jan payroll.

vince-mgr: Marta — I approve emergency compassionate leave. Please file the portal request and attach anything you have. I can approve immediately. :thumbsup:

marta-eng: Submitted EX-2027-4422, attached hospital note. Booking now. Thanks so much.

payroll-bot: FYI payroll cutoff for year-end cash changes is Dec 15. Requests after that default to non-cash shutdown credit paid in next cycle.

olivia-peopleops: Got EX-2027-4422 and Vince's approval. Per payroll cutoff we'll grant 3 compassionate days as paid shutdown credit and mark them separate from PTO. Marta — sending DM with confirmation and calendar block. Safe travels.

tom-cover: Marta — I can cover your on-call rotation Dec 24-26. LMK what handover you need and I'll coordinate.

marta-eng: Tom, really appreciate it. I'll drop notes in the on-call doc and share runbook. Thanks everyone.
